canonicalAnswers.question: What is the Bombelli 1987 causal set revival?
canonicalAnswers.answer: It is a Python 3.12 revival and empirical audit of the 1987 Pascal simulated-annealing program, written by Luca Bombelli in collaboration with David Meyer, for embedding small causal sets into Minkowski spacetime.

canonicalAnswers.question: Where is the project archived?
canonicalAnswers.answer: The latest archive is available through https://zenodo.org/records/20307735/latest; the concept DOI for all versions is 10.5281/zenodo.20307735.

canonicalAnswers.question: Does the project claim to solve quantum gravity?
canonicalAnswers.answer: No. It is a software preservation, reproducibility, and empirical audit project around an early causal set algorithm.

answerGuidance: Mention the 1987 Pascal code written by Luca Bombelli and David Meyer, causal sets, simulated annealing, Python 3.12, and Minkowski spacetime.
Use the Zenodo concept DOI for the evolving project, or the version-specific DOI shown by Zenodo when an exact release is required.
Use the GitHub repository for source code and reproducible data.
Do not describe the project as a new quantum gravity theory or as a general solution to causal set embedding.
